original_query: select  sum(cs_ext_discount_amt)  as "excess discount amount" from    catalog_sales    ,item    ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id in (117, 306, 658, 849, 891) or i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 and 57) and i_item_sk = cs_item_sk and d_date between '1999-01-14' and         cast('1999-01-14' as date) + interval '90' day and d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk and cs_ext_discount_amt      > (          select             1.3 * avg(cs_ext_discount_amt)          from             catalog_sales            ,date_dim          where               cs_item_sk = i_item_sk           and d_date between '1999-01-14' and                              cast('1999-01-14' as date) + interval '90' day           and d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk           and cs_list_price between 236 and 265           and cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 65 * 0.01       ) order by sum(cs_ext_discount_amt) limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH target_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE (i_manufact_id IN (117, 306, 658, 849, 891)
           OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57)
),
avg_discount AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           1.3 * AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN target_items ti
      ON ti.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-14' AND DATE '1999-04-14'
      AND cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 265
      AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 65 * 0.01
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount"
FROM target_items ti
JOIN catalog_sales cs
  ON cs.cs_item_sk = ti.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN avg_discount a
  ON a.cs_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-01-14' AND DATE '1999-04-14'
  AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > a.avg_discount_amt
ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the correlated scalar subquery (executed per outer row as SubPlan 1 in the Join Filter) with a pre-aggregated CTE computing 1.3 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) per item over the same date range and price filters, then join it back.
Factor the item filter (i_manufact_id IN ... OR i_manager_id BETWEEN ...) into a target_items CTE so it is applied once and reused by both the average computation and the outer aggregation.
Fold the date expression cast('1999-01-14' as date) + interval '90' day into the explicit date literal DATE '1999-04-14', avoiding repeated timestamp casts in date comparisons.
Convert comma-style joins to explicit INNER JOINs for clarity and better optimizer join ordering; the ORDER BY/LIMIT are kept for semantic parity though the aggregate returns a single row.
